title: Impact of climate transition risk on capital income share: evidence from China
title_zh: 气候转型风险对资本收入份额的影响：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 气候转型风险对资本收入份额的影响：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Impact of climate transition risk on capital income share: evidence from China
authors: Dongliang Pan, Chao Wang, Shengmin Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Leveraging China’s signing of the Paris Agreement as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper examines how climate transition risk shapes the capital share of income at the firm level. Using a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2007–2023, we document that exposure to climate transition risk leads to a statistically significant increase in firms’ capital income share. This finding remains robust to a battery of endogeneity and sensitivity checks. Mechanism analyses indicate that climate transition risk operates through multiple channels: it reduces operating costs, induces capital deepening, accelerates technological progress, and reshapes labour–capital relations, jointly contributing to a higher capital share of income. Heterogeneity tests further show that the effect is more pronounced in regions with lower energy consumption and higher levels of public environmental awareness. Overall, the results offer a novel perspective from the lens of green transition for understanding shifts in the functional distribution of income. KEYWORDS: Climate transition risk capital income share capital deepening technological progress labour–capital relations JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 O12
abstract_zh: 本文以中国签署《巴黎协定》作为准自然实验，考察气候转型风险如何影响企业层面的收入资本份额。利用2007—2023年中国A股上市公司面板数据，我们发现气候转型风险暴露显著提高了企业的资本收入份额。该结论在一系列内生性与敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析表明，气候转型风险通过多重渠道发挥作用：降低经营成本、促进资本深化、加速技术进步以及重塑劳资关系，共同推动资本收入份额上升。异质性检验进一步显示，在能源消费较低、公众环保意识较高的地区，该效应更为显著。总体而言，本文从绿色转型视角为理解功能性收入分配变化提供了新的视角。关键词：气候转型风险；资本收入份额；资本深化；技术进步；劳资关系 JEL分类：G32；O12

title: Beyond the Private Sphere: Women's Community Participation and Household Diet Quality in Rural China
title_zh: 超越私人领域：中国农村女性社区参与与家庭膳食质量
title_primary: 超越私人领域：中国农村女性社区参与与家庭膳食质量
title_secondary: Beyond the Private Sphere: Women's Community Participation and Household Diet Quality in Rural China
authors: Fei Wang, Jiaqi Huang, Jinghui Hao
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Improving diet quality remains a key challenge in post‐poverty rural China. This study examines how women's community participation, a form of public‐sphere agency, relates to household diet quality. We introduce a Food‐Weighted Dietary Diversity Index (FWDDI) that captures variation in diet quality beyond adequacy thresholds in broadly adequate settings and apply it to a three‐wave household panel. Fixed‐effects estimates show a positive association between women's community participation and household diet quality. This association is reflected in broader and more nutrient‐dense diets, with little change in consumption frequency, and in the corresponding pattern in women's intrahousehold decision‐making, consistent with information diffusion and women's decision influence as plausible pathways. This association is concentrated in women's participation in economic activities, among ever‐registered‐poor households and in villages with male agricultural wage premiums. These findings point to women's public engagement, especially in economic activities, as a potential channel for improving household diet quality, particularly where household resource constraints are tighter and women are at a wage disadvantage in local labour markets.
abstract_zh: 改善饮食质量仍是后贫困时代中国农村面临的关键挑战。本研究探讨女性社区参与——一种公共领域能动性形式——如何与家庭饮食质量相关联。我们引入了一个食物加权膳食多样性指数（FWDDI），该指数能够捕捉在总体充足情境下超越充足阈值的饮食质量差异，并将其应用于三轮家庭面板数据。固定效应估计显示，女性社区参与与家庭饮食质量之间存在正向关联。这一关联体现在更广泛且营养密度更高的饮食结构中，而消费频率变化甚微，同时与女性家庭内部决策权的相应模式相吻合，这与信息扩散和女性决策影响力作为合理的作用路径相一致。该关联集中于女性参与经济活动的情形，在曾登记贫困家庭以及存在男性农业工资溢价的村庄中尤为显著。这些发现表明，女性公共参与，尤其是经济活动的参与，是改善家庭饮食质量的潜在渠道，特别是在家庭资源约束更为紧张且女性在当地劳动力市场中处于工资劣势的情况下。

title: DP769 Migration Theory and Evidence: An Assessment
title_zh: 迁移理论与证据：一项评估
title_primary: 迁移理论与证据：一项评估
title_secondary: DP769 Migration Theory and Evidence: An Assessment
authors: Paul Levine, Subrata Ghatak, Diogo Britto, Clément Imbert, Breno Sampaio 等
official: 官方在线 1993-03-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper presents a critical survey of theories of migration, their welfare and policy implications and their empirical relevance. We also develop some extensions to the theory beginning with a general encompassing model of migration which treats the Harris and Todaro (HT) model as a special case. In particular, we show how standard policy, a reduction of the wage gap between an advanced and a backward region to reduce the rate of migration, follows from the standard model, but ceases to be valid if borrowing constraints on the potential migrant are introduced. The HT model is extended to examine risk-averse behaviour within families where the migration of members of families serves to diversify risk. The welfare implications of the individual migration decision and government intervention in the form of employment subsidies are also examined.
abstract_zh: 本文对迁移理论、其福利与政策含义及实证相关性进行了批判性综述。我们首先构建了一个涵盖性迁移模型，将哈里斯-托达罗（HT）模型作为特例纳入其中，并在此基础上对理论进行了若干拓展。具体而言，我们展示了标准政策——即通过缩小发达地区与欠发达地区之间的工资差距来降低迁移率——如何从标准模型中推导得出，但若引入潜在迁移者的借贷约束，该政策便不再有效。此外，我们对HT模型进行了扩展，以考察家庭内部的风险规避行为，其中家庭成员迁移旨在分散风险。本文还探讨了个人迁移决策的福利含义，以及政府以就业补贴形式进行干预的影响。

title: DP49 Subsidisation vs Information Provision as Instruments of Technology Policy
title_zh: 技术政策工具：补贴与信息提供
title_primary: 技术政策工具：补贴与信息提供
title_secondary: DP49 Subsidisation vs Information Provision as Instruments of Technology Policy
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: One of the aims of government policy has been to speed up the diffusion of new technologies. This aim has been pursued largely by policies aimed at improving information about the technology or by subsidising the purchase of new technology. In this paper we construct a simple diffusion model that integrates the two dominant themes in the literature, one stressing learning and the other stressing differences between potential adopters. We investigate the impact of learning and subsidy policies on the diffusion path and the welfare implications of these policies. It is argued that the market structure of the industry supplying the new technology is a key factor determining the impacts of the policies. It should therefore be considered when choosing whether government should intervene and if so, what instruments should be used.
abstract_zh: 政府政策的目标之一是加速新技术的扩散。这一目标主要通过改善技术信息或补贴新技术购买的政策来实现。本文构建了一个简单的扩散模型，整合了文献中的两大主流主题：一个强调学习，另一个强调潜在采用者之间的差异。我们研究了学习政策和补贴政策对扩散路径的影响，以及这些政策的福利含义。研究表明，供应新技术的行业市场结构是决定政策影响的关键因素。因此，在选择政府是否干预以及采用何种工具时，应充分考虑这一因素。

title: Balancing cultivated land benchmark prices using a method integrating rank adjustment and spatial association
title_zh: 整合秩调整与空间关联的耕地基准价格平衡方法
title_primary: 整合秩调整与空间关联的耕地基准价格平衡方法
title_secondary: Balancing cultivated land benchmark prices using a method integrating rank adjustment and spatial association
authors: Yajie Zhang, Baiyang Fu, Zhiyi Duan, Xuesong Kong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Balancing cultivated land prices is widely regarded as a key approach for mitigating interregional disparities in land valuation. However, conventional approaches have largely neglected the consistency between cultivated land price rankings and regional development hierarchies. To bridge this gap, this study develops an integrated framework that combines rank adjustment with spatial association analysis to capture cross-boundary price interactions and spillover effects, based on a newly introduced cultivated land price balance index. We demonstrate this framework by applying it to optimize the cultivated land benchmark price (CLBP) system in Hubei Province, China. Our analysis reveals pronounced spatial misalignment between CLBP and regional development patterns, with systematic overvaluation in underdeveloped western counties and undervaluation in developed central areas. After balancing, the results depict a distinct east-high and west-low pricing gradient, forming a “one-core, two-satellite” spatial structure of land values that better corresponds with Hubei’s regional development strategies and territorial planning objectives. The proposed model overcomes key limitations of traditional land price evaluation frameworks, as demonstrated by correlation tests with a state‑audited benchmark dataset of cultivated land. This study provides both a methodological advance in cultivated land price system refinement and theoretical insights into the spatial interaction mechanisms between regional development and land value formation. abstract_zh: 平衡耕地价格被广泛视为缓解区域间土地估值差异的关键途径。然而，传统方法在很大程度上忽视了耕地价格排序与区域发展层级之间的一致性。为弥补这一不足，本研究构建了一个整合框架，将排序调整与空间关联分析相结合，基于新引入的耕地价格平衡指数，捕捉跨边界价格互动与溢出效应。我们通过将该框架应用于优化中国湖北省耕地基准地价（CLBP）体系来加以验证。分析结果显示，CLBP与区域发展格局之间存在显著的空间错位，欠发达西部县域存在系统性高估，而发达中部地区则存在低估。经过平衡调整后，结果呈现出明显的东高西低价格梯度，形成“一核两卫星”的土地价值空间结构，与湖北省区域发展战略及国土空间规划目标更为契合。通过与国家级审计基准数据集的耕地数据相关性检验，所提出的模型克服了传统土地价格评估框架的关键局限。本研究既为耕地价格体系优化提供了方法论进展，也为区域发展与土地价值形成之间的空间互动机制提供了理论洞见。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图片（211KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图片

title: Multiplicative Modular Nim (MuM)
abstract: We introduce Multiplicative Modular Nim (MuM), a variant of Nim in which the traditional nim-sum is replaced by heap-size multiplication modulo m. We establish a complete theory for this game, beginning with a direct, Bouton-style analysis for prime moduli. Our central result is an analogue of the Sprague-Grundy theorem, where we define a game-theoretic value, the mumber, for each position via a multiplicative mex recursion. We prove that these mumbers are equivalent to the heap-product modulo m, and show that multiplicative composition of MuM positions is governed by modular multiplication, in contrast to classical Nim where composition is governed by XOR (nim-sum). For composite moduli, we show that MuM decomposes via the Chinese Remainder Theorem into independent subgames corresponding to its prime-power factors. We extend the game to finite fields \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$\mathbb {F}(p^n)$$\end{document}, motivated by the pedagogical need to make the algebra of the AES S-box more accessible. We demonstrate that a sound game in this domain requires an integer heap model with synonym-move exclusion to resolve the many-to-one mapping from integer heaps to field elements. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of a multiplicative modular variant of Nim and its extension into a complete, non-additive combinatorial game algebra.

title: When e‐commerce meets smallholders: Boosting incomes and widening gaps in rural China's anti‐poverty policy
title_zh: 电子商务遇上小农户：中国农村扶贫政策中的收入提升与差距扩大
title_primary: 电子商务遇上小农户：中国农村扶贫政策中的收入提升与差距扩大
title_secondary: When e‐commerce meets smallholders: Boosting incomes and widening gaps in rural China's anti‐poverty policy
authors: Wenqi Duan, Mingming Jiang, Jianhong Qi, Qing Shi
abstract: Lifting smallholder farmers out of poverty depends largely on boosting their agricultural operating incomes, a persistent challenge despite numerous efforts. This study evaluates the impact of China's “E‐Commerce into the Countryside” (ECC) program—the first and largest e‐commerce initiative in the developing world—on both the level and distribution of smallholders' farm earnings. Employing a quasi‐experimental design, we find that the ECC program significantly increases household per capita agricultural operating income. We show that this gain is driven by expanded market access through online sales, which facilitate income growth via three primary mechanisms: operational scale expansion, higher output prices, and a shift toward high‐value‐added crops. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed. The program also widens the income gap among smallholders, a disparity largely attributable to pre‐existing differences in human, productive, and digital capital. Our findings highlight that e‐commerce policies, while potent for income generation, require complementary measures to mitigate disparities that arise from heterogeneous initial endowments.
abstract_zh: 使小农户摆脱贫困在很大程度上取决于提高其农业经营收入，尽管付出了诸多努力，这仍是一项长期挑战。本研究评估了中国"电子商务进农村"（ECC）计划——发展中国家首个也是规模最大的电子商务举措——对小农户农业收入水平及分布的影响。采用准实验设计，我们发现ECC计划显著提高了家庭人均农业经营收入。研究表明，这一增长源于通过在线销售扩大市场准入，并通过三种主要机制促进收入增长：经营规模扩大、产出价格提高以及向高附加值作物转型。然而，这些收益的分配并不均衡。该计划还扩大了小农户之间的收入差距，这种差距在很大程度上可归因于人力资本、生产资本和数字资本的既有差异。我们的研究结果表明，电子商务政策虽能有效促进收入增长，但需要配套措施来缓解因初始禀赋异质性而产生的差距。

title: Socioeconomic and environmental challenges affecting sustainable land management in Africa: A systematic review towards integrated framework proposal
title_zh: 影响非洲可持续土地管理的社会经济和环境挑战：面向综合框架提案的系统综述
title_primary: 影响非洲可持续土地管理的社会经济和环境挑战：面向综合框架提案的系统综述
title_secondary: Socioeconomic and environmental challenges affecting sustainable land management in Africa: A systematic review towards integrated framework proposal
authors: Titus Adeyemi Alonge, Nabiebakye Henrietta, Michael Addaney, Jonas Ayaribilla Akudugu, Rejoice Selorm Wireko-Gyebi 等
official: 来源期次 Land Use Policy, Volume 169 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Sustainable land management (SLM) is widely recognised as central to addressing land degradation, strengthening agricultural productivity, and enhancing ecosystem resilience across Africa. However, implementation remains uneven and is constrained by interacting socioeconomic, environmental, and institutional factors. A systematic review of peer-reviewed literature published between 2010 and 2023 was conducted using the Scopus and Google Scholar databases, resulting in 45 eligible studies, which were analysed using inductive thematic analysis. The results revealed three dominant categories of constraints: environmental, economic, and social, with environmental degradation, particularly soil erosion, deforestation, and climate variability, being the most frequently reported. However, the review demonstrates that underlying governance challenges, including insecure land tenure, land fragmentation, limited access to resources, weak land-use planning, and administrative inefficiency, largely drive these environmental pressures. Co-occurrence patterns further highlight a key research gap: most studies examine constraints in isolation, despite their systemic interdependence. Geographically, research is heavily concentrated in East Africa, especially Ethiopia, while Central Africa and parts of North Africa remain under-represented. This study’s novelty lies in integrating fragmented evidence into a unified analytical perspective and proposing an Integrated Sustainable Land Management (ISLM) framework that links institutional capacity, tenure security, economic incentives, and ecological restoration. The findings provide actionable insights for policymakers and researchers by supporting coordinated, cross-sectoral SLM strategies tailored to the diverse African land governance contexts.
abstract_zh: 可持续土地管理（SLM）被广泛认为是应对非洲土地退化、增强农业生产力和提升生态系统韧性的核心举措。然而，其实施仍不均衡，并受到社会经济、环境和制度因素相互作用的制约。本研究利用Scopus和Google Scholar数据库，对2010年至2023年间发表的同行评审文献进行了系统综述，筛选出45项符合条件的研究，并采用归纳性主题分析进行分析。结果显示，制约因素主要分为三类：环境、经济和社会因素，其中环境退化，尤其是土壤侵蚀、森林砍伐和气候变率，是最常被报告的制约因素。然而，综述表明，潜在的治理挑战，包括土地权属不稳定、土地碎片化、资源获取受限、土地利用规划薄弱以及行政效率低下，在很大程度上驱动了这些环境压力。共现模式进一步凸显了一个关键研究空白：大多数研究孤立地考察制约因素，尽管它们在系统层面相互依存。在地理分布上，研究高度集中于东非，尤其是埃塞俄比亚，而中非和北非部分地区则代表性不足。本研究的创新之处在于将分散的证据整合为统一的分析视角，并提出一个综合可持续土地管理（ISLM）框架，将制度能力、权属保障、经济激励和生态恢复联系起来。研究结果为政策制定者和研究人员提供了可操作的见解，有助于制定适应非洲多样化土地治理背景的协调、跨部门SLM战略。

title: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
title_zh: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力买方垄断压价
title_primary: 谁承担成本：金融摩擦与劳动力买方垄断压价
title_secondary: Who bears the cost: Financial frictions and labor markdown
authors: Ming Li, Yao Amber Li, Zehao Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present evidence of a connection between bank concentration and labor markdown in China. Using a large dataset on bank branch distribution and firm performance in China, we document that financial friction in the local market leads to significantly higher firm-level labor markdowns but has little impact on firms’ product markup and profitability. This suggests that firms pass the impact of financial friction to the labor market by exploiting labor when faced with higher financial costs. Such transmission of financial friction is more salient among low-skill-intensity or non-state-owned firms, and greater labor mobility facilitates the transmission. Our findings highlight the distributional effect of financial friction in the economy: labor, especially the low-skilled ones, rather than capital, eventually bears the cost of financial friction.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了中国银行业集中度与劳动力市场买方垄断力之间关联的证据。利用中国银行分支机构分布与企业绩效的大型数据集，我们记录了本地市场金融摩擦导致企业层面劳动力买方垄断力显著提高，但对企业的产品加成率和盈利能力影响甚微。这表明，企业在面临更高财务成本时，通过剥削劳动力将金融摩擦的影响转嫁给劳动力市场。这种金融摩擦的传导在低技能密集度或非国有企业中更为显著，而更大的劳动力流动性促进了这一传导。我们的发现强调了金融摩擦在经济中的分配效应：劳动力，尤其是低技能劳动者，而非资本，最终承担了金融摩擦的成本。

title: Epidemic mortality and redistribution of housing wealth in Leiden, 1632–1668
title_zh: 1632–1668年莱顿流行病死亡率与住房财富再分配
title_primary: 1632–1668年莱顿流行病死亡率与住房财富再分配
title_secondary: Epidemic mortality and redistribution of housing wealth in Leiden, 1632–1668
authors: Bram van Besouw, Daniel R. Curtis, Roos van Oosten
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How did epidemic mortality affect housing wealth in the pre-industrial period? Using new data on house ownership and variation in street-level mortality in seventeenth-century Leiden, we show that although epidemic mortality targeted poor streets where residents were typically tenants and not owners, these outbreaks still increased the turnover of houses. Ordinarily, turnover was higher in owner-occupied housing sectors, while epidemics created more turnover for low-value houses consolidated in the hands of wealthy investors. In combination with a lack of house price adjustments due to rapid demographic recovery after epidemics, this meant that houses were passed between long-standing owners with similar housing wealth profiles. As a result, epidemics did not affect aggregate housing wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 流行病死亡率如何影响前工业化时期的住房财富？利用关于房屋所有权的新数据以及十七世纪莱顿街道层面死亡率的变异，我们表明，尽管流行病死亡率主要针对贫困街道，那里的居民通常是租户而非业主，但这些疫情仍然增加了房屋的流转率。通常情况下，业主自住住房部门的流转率较高，而疫情则为集中在富裕投资者手中的低价值房屋带来了更多流转。结合疫情后人口迅速恢复导致房价缺乏调整的情况，这意味着房屋在具有相似住房财富特征的老业主之间传递。因此，疫情并未影响总体住房财富不平等。

title: Information and Social Norms: Experimental Evidence on the Labor Market Aspirations of Saudi Women
title_zh: 信息与社会规范：沙特女性劳动力市场抱负的实验证据
title_primary: 信息与社会规范：沙特女性劳动力市场抱负的实验证据
title_secondary: Information and Social Norms: Experimental Evidence on the Labor Market Aspirations of Saudi Women
authors: Monira Essa Aloud, Sara Al-Rashood, Ina Ganguli, Basit Zafar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How important are social norms, information gaps and family constraints in explaining the low rates of female labor force participation (FLFP) in conservative societies? To answer this question, we conducted a field experiment embedded in a survey of female university students at a large public university in Saudi Arabia. We randomly provided one subset of individuals with information on the labor market and aspirations of their female peers (T1), while another subset was provided with this information along with a prime that made their parents more salient (T2). We find that expectations of working among those in the Control group are quite high, yet students underestimate the expected labor force attachment of their female peers. We show that social information matters: relative to the Control group, expectations about own labor force participation are significantly higher in the T1 group, which is driven primarily by receiving information about their peers' aspirations. We show that T2, as intended, causes students to report a higher importance of parents' approval of their choices. However, we do not find that the impact of information is counteracted by evoking parental expectations: impacts for the T2 group on labor market expectations are not smaller than those for T1 group. However, T2 does lead to higher expectations of working in Education and the Public sectors -sectors that are more socially acceptable for women, suggesting that parental expectations their daughters' labor market aspirations but partly shape them.
abstract_zh: 社会规范、信息差距和家庭约束在解释保守社会中女性劳动力参与率（FLFP）偏低方面有多重要？为回答这一问题，我们在沙特阿拉伯一所大型公立大学对女大学生进行了一项嵌入调查的实地实验。我们随机向一组受试者提供了关于其女性同龄人在劳动力市场和 aspirations 方面的信息（T1），而另一组则在此基础上额外获得了一种提示，使她们父母的重要性更加凸显（T2）。我们发现，对照组中对工作的期望相当高，但学生们低估了其女性同龄人的预期劳动力参与度。我们证明，社会信息具有重要性：与对照组相比，T1组中对自身劳动力参与度的期望显著更高，这主要源于接收到关于同龄人 aspirations 的信息。我们表明，T2 按预期导致学生报告父母对其选择认可的重要性更高。然而，我们并未发现信息的影响因唤起父母期望而被抵消：T2组对劳动力市场期望的影响并不小于T1组。但T2确实导致了对教育和公共部门工作期望的更高值——这些部门对女性而言更具社会接受度，这表明父母的期望并未削弱女儿的劳动力市场 aspirations，但在一定程度上塑造了它们。

title: Does Field of Study Shape the Gender Wage Gap? The Role of Migration Background
title_zh: 研究领域是否影响性别工资差距？移民背景的作用
title_primary: 研究领域是否影响性别工资差距？移民背景的作用
title_secondary: Does Field of Study Shape the Gender Wage Gap? The Role of Migration Background
authors: Devos, Louise, Rycx, François, Senterre, Thomas, Volral, Mélanie, Devos, Louise Margot
official: 官方在线 2026-05-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62, 000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
abstract_zh: 本文利用超过62,000名硕士毕业生的匹配雇主-雇员数据，考察了不同专业领域的工资回报如何因移民背景而呈现性别差异，以及教育专业化如何影响性别工资差距。我们通过估计工资回归方程并采用分解方法，将不同专业领域的筛选效应与同一专业领域内的薪酬差异区分开来。各专业领域的回报差异显著，其中法律、经济与管理以及科学领域的回报最高，且在所有专业领域内女性收入均低于男性，尤其是在高薪领域。无论专业领域如何，来自发展中国家的第一代移民获得的回报最低，而第二代移民虽接近但未能完全达到本土出生者的水平。专业领域解释了本土出生者和第二代移民中性别工资不平等的相当大一部分，但在第一代移民中，更广泛的工资劣势占据主导地位。研究结果还因父母来自发展中国家的数量以及移民抵达时的年龄而呈现差异。

title: Financial literacy and financial crime: A regression discontinuity approach
title_zh: 金融素养与金融犯罪：基于断点回归方法的研究
title_primary: 金融素养与金融犯罪：基于断点回归方法的研究
title_secondary: Financial literacy and financial crime: A regression discontinuity approach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how financial literacy shapes the propensity of individuals to commit financial crime. Using state-level administrative data on criminal charges linked to comprehensive public records , we exploit a policy-based discontinuity in grade level assignment based on individual birth dates that exogenously requires certain high school cohorts to attend a financial literacy course. Our estimates suggest that exposure to the course reduces the propensity to commit financial crime by 37%. The reduction is driven by declines in embezzlement and is stronger for low-income individuals. Additional evidence suggests that the reductions are primarily explained by improvements in household balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了金融素养如何影响个体实施金融犯罪的倾向。利用与全面公共记录相关联的州级刑事指控行政数据，我们基于个体出生日期所导致的年级分配政策不连续性，外生地要求某些高中群体参加金融素养课程。估计结果显示，接触该课程使实施金融犯罪的倾向降低了37%。这一减少主要由贪污行为的下降驱动，且对低收入个体影响更为显著。进一步证据表明，这些减少主要归因于家庭资产负债表的改善。

title: Reducing misinformation on social media: an experimental evaluation of two policy interventions
title_zh: 减少社交媒体上的错误信息：两项政策干预的实验评估
title_primary: 减少社交媒体上的错误信息：两项政策干预的实验评估
title_secondary: Reducing misinformation on social media: an experimental evaluation of two policy interventions
abstract: The prevalence of false and misleading news has become an issue of great concern in recent years. Academic researchers, policymakers, and social media firms all continue to seek effective solutions to reduce the sharing of misinformation. In this paper, we evaluate the effectiveness of two policies in particular: competition among media firms and fact-checking of published news articles by independent organizations. We first develop a theoretical model that predicts the effect of each policy and then conduct a behavioral experiment to test those predictions. Our experimental findings indicate that media competition is most effective at nipping misinformation in the bud because media firms spend significantly more resources on improving the accuracy of their news when readers obtain news from multiple sources. We also find that fact-checking improves the overall quality of news available to viewers; however, it does not incentivize firms to improve the accuracy of their own news articles. Last, our results from an interaction treatment suggest that under competition, fact-checking adversely affects firms’ investment in news accuracy.
abstract_zh: 近年来，虚假与误导性新闻的泛滥已成为备受关注的社会问题。学术界、政策制定者及社交媒体平台持续探索减少虚假信息传播的有效方案。本文重点评估两项政策的实施效果：媒体企业间的竞争机制，以及独立机构对已发布新闻文章的事实核查机制。我们首先构建理论模型预测各项政策的影响效应，继而通过行为实验验证这些预测。实验结果表明，媒体竞争在遏制虚假信息萌芽阶段最为有效——当读者通过多渠道获取新闻时，媒体企业会显著增加资源投入以提升新闻准确性。研究同时发现，事实核查虽能改善受众可获取新闻的整体质量，但并未激励企业提升自身新闻的准确性。最后，交互处理组的实验结果显示，在竞争环境下，事实核查反而对企业的新闻准确性投资产生负面影响。

title: It makes a village: child care and prosociality
title_zh: 托育服务与亲社会行为：村庄的构建
title_primary: 托育服务与亲社会行为：村庄的构建
title_secondary: It makes a village: child care and prosociality
authors: Alessandra Cassar, Alejandrina Cristia, Pauline Grosjean, Sarah Walker
abstract: We examine the relationship between allomaternal care (i.e., care for children by individuals other than the mother) and prosociality (reciprocity and altruism). Motivated by ethnographic evidence of a positive association between allomaternal care and societal trust across cultures, we design an economic experiment to measure the relationship between allomaternal care and cooperative behavior among 820 participants in small scale societies of the Solomon Islands. Our results show that receiving help with child care predicts higher levels of reciprocity towards the helper. This relationship remains robust for mothers even after accounting for participant fixed effects, for the nature of the relationship between mother and helper, and for other forms of mutual assistance. Moreover, help from non-relatives is associated with altruism toward strangers, suggesting a novel channel for the development of impersonal prosociality. Strengthening the case for the importance of allomaternal care for human development, we report suggestive evidence of potential socio-cognitive benefits to children who receive care from non-relatives (based on daylong recordings of 197 children analyzed using a multilingually-trained neural network), as well as societal-level benefits in terms of economic growth. abstract_zh: 我们考察了异母照料（即非母亲个体对儿童的照料）与亲社会性（互惠与利他）之间的关系。受跨文化民族志证据表明异母照料与社会信任呈正相关的启发，我们设计了一项经济实验，以测量所罗门群岛小型社会中820名参与者的异母照料与合作行为之间的关系。研究结果显示，获得育儿帮助预示着对帮助者具有更高水平的互惠行为。即使在控制参与者固定效应、母亲与帮助者之间的关系性质以及其他形式的互助后，这一关系对母亲而言依然稳健。此外，来自非亲属的帮助与对陌生人的利他行为相关，这揭示了非人格化亲社会性发展的新渠道。为强化异母照料对人类发展重要性的论证，我们报告了提示性证据：接受非亲属照料的儿童可能获得社会认知方面的益处（基于对197名儿童全天录音的分析，采用多语言训练的神经网络），以及在社会层面促进经济增长的潜在效益。类似内容被其他人浏览。
